# Exact set of sorryAx-tainted public Cslib declarations. Generated by
# scripts/check-axiom-census.sh --update -- do not hand-edit.
#
# This is a frozen, exact-set baseline keyed on column 1 (declaration name) ONLY.
# Columns 2 (owning file) and 3 (reason) are D1 debt-ledger metadata -- a durable
# anchor of declaration name + owning file + in-source blocking reason, deliberately
# not a task number (see .claude/rules/no-task-references-in-deliverables.md). They
# are NOT compared: a changed reason for an already-tainted declaration never fails
# this check, only a name entering or leaving the tainted set does.
#
# A live tainted name NOT in this list is new silent sorryAx taint this fork
# introduced and fails the check. A baseline name no longer tainted live is an
# improvement; re-run --update to ratchet the baseline down and commit the result.
#
# Format: <declaration name>\t<owning file>\t<reason>
